name: Sindragosa
shortDescription: The undead frost wyrm who guards the way to the Lich King in Icecrown Citadel.
body: The undead frost wyrm who guards the way to the Lich King in Icecrown Citadel. Original interpretive illustration, not canonical game art. See docs/research/shadowmourne-and-arthas-relics-visual-assets.json for references and open model review.
